title: Switching failure under Boolean duality
statement: Let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ be a Boolean function, let $k$ be a natural number, and let $\rho$ assign a coordinate restriction to each of the $n$ coordinates. Define the Boolean dual by $f^{*}(x)=-f(-x)$, and let $-\rho$ denote the assignment obtained by negating each fixed state while leaving free coordinates free. The switching failure indicator of $f^{*}$ at threshold $k$ and assignment $\rho$ equals that of $f$ at threshold $k$ and assignment $-\rho$.
hypotheses_covered: Coordinate restriction assignment on the $n$ coordinates
